subject: Data Engineering
title: Anomaly Detection for Data
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Anomaly Detection for Data.

hook.text: Revenue usually grows 2% monthly. This month it jumped 40%. Is that a win or a bug?

buildup.text: Anomaly detection applies statistical models to data metrics, flagging values outside normal ranges.

discovery.text: Time-series models learn seasonal patterns and detect when today's data deviates from expectations.

twist.text: Not every anomaly is a bug. Black Friday spikes are real. The hard part is separating signal from noise.

climax.text: Good anomaly detection reduces alert fatigue by learning what's normal for each specific dataset.

punchline.text: Catch the unexpected. Ignore the explainable.

quiz.question: What is the main challenge of anomaly detection for data quality?
options: Distinguishing real problems from legitimate unusual events
Anomaly detection is too slow to use
